x-provenance.basis: The Leader's words name a chain of hosts each beneath the last and call each an ASSIST instance. The ASSIST package specification of 2026-10-10 (pass assist) already states that an instance names a parent, inherits every field it does not override, and is served at a host whose label chain mirrors its parent chain; R1, R2 and R4 restate those for the grow-assist chain and trace to it. R3, R5 and R6 are what the chain adds: a child never drops or widens a parent's constraint, the site directory sits in the owning section, and knowledge is read from the ancestors' sections' records.

board-opening.need: ASSIST serves chains of instances, each a specialization of its parent, so that grow.assist.561.group down to minnesota.indoor.cannabis.grow.assist.561.group are one engine configured four times.

requirements.says: The ASSIST package shall admit an Assist instance record that names at most one parent instance.
The ASSIST package shall compute an instance's effective configuration as its parent's effective configuration with the instance's own fields overriding or adding to it.
requirements.rationale: 'mirrors/fractals': each instance is its parent plus what is particular to it.

requirements.says: An Assist instance's specialization shall add knowledge records, add tools and narrow constraints, never removing or widening a constraint its parent states.
requirements.rationale: A child of a jurisdiction-free instance may add a jurisdiction governor; a Minnesota leaf may not drop it.

requirements.says: Each Assist instance shall be served at a host formed by prefixing one DNS label to its parent's host, the root instances being served at <name>.assist.561.group.
Each Assist instance's site directory shall sit at sites/<host>/ in the services section that owns the instance, beside that section's knowledge records in data/records.
requirements.rationale: Leader 2026-10-10: '.../personal-minnesota-indoor-cannabis-grow-services-section/sites/minnesota.indoor.cannabis.grow.assist.561.group/ should then be an ASSIST instance'.

requirements.says: The ASSIST package shall serve an instance's knowledge from the records its owning section and its ancestors' sections hold, never from literals in a seat.
requirements.rationale: Assist application platform v0.3.0, 'Knowledge as data'; Leader 2026-10-10: in-repo resources thicker than out-of-repo resources.

conditions.says: The grow-assist instance-chain specification exists and its four instance records name their parents.
